title: Vaccinium myrtillus tea for medicinal use
intro: Vaccinium myrtillus tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and berries of the bilberry plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its rich content of antioxidants, particularly anthocyanins, which are believed to support eye health and improve circulation. This tea is often consumed to alleviate symptoms of eye fatigue, enhance vision, and promote cardiovascular wellness. It may also be used to support urinary tract health and reduce inflammation. In some traditional practices, it is combined with other herbs to address conditions like diabetes and hypertension.
